name: cohesivity-sites
description: Temporary backends for agent-built apps — hosting, Postgres, object storage, email, AI inference, and more via HTTP API. No account needed.

authentication.setup: Keys are created automatically by `npx --yes @cohesivity/init@0.8.2 --tenant-only` and written to a local `.cohesivity` file. No account, sign-up, or OAuth needed.

privacy.disclosure: Source code is uploaded to Cohesivity hosting during deploy. Database contents and stored files reside on Cohesivity infrastructure. Ephemeral tenants and all data expire after 72 hours.

lifecycle.install: Copies skills/sites/SKILL.md into the agent's skill directory. Creates nothing until the user asks to deploy.
lifecycle.disable: Removing the skill file stops all Cohesivity API calls.
lifecycle.uninstall: Delete the skill file and any project-local `.cohesivity` credential file. No background processes or daemons to stop.

failure.noCredentials: Skill instructs the agent to run the bootstrap command. If bootstrap fails, the agent reports the error and stops.
failure.offline: HTTP calls return a network error; the agent reports it and stops. No retry loop.
failure.providerError: Non-2xx responses are reported with status and body. No secrets are included in error output.
